title: The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game
subtitle: Cooperative tactical deck construction through perilous quests across Middle-earth
tagline: A fellowship of heroes against the gathering shadow
loreSummary: Middle-earth teeters on the brink of ruin. As Dark forces muster, a band of heroes unites across kingdoms and ancient alliances to undertake perilous quests, protect the innocent, and defy the Dark Lord.
keyFeatures: Deep custom deck construction across four complementary spheres of influence
Staging area threat management and simultaneous quest resolution
Campaign mode with persistent boons, burdens, and hero casualty tracking
Solo and multi-hero scalability against iconic Tolkien adversaries

lotr_mirkwood_campaign.name: Mirkwood Campaign Experience (8 Quests)
lotr_mirkwood_campaign.description: The complete introductory campaign arc connecting the core quests with the Dark of Mirkwood narrative scenario pack.

lotr_core_trio.name: Core Set Trilogy (3 Quests)
lotr_core_trio.description: The foundational triad of adventures: Passage Through Mirkwood, Journey Along the Anduin, and Escape from Dol Guldur.

lotr_fellowship_saga.name: Fellowship of the Ring Saga (12 Quests)
lotr_fellowship_saga.description: An epic full-cycle journey traversing the classic narrative beats of the First Volume of the Ring trilogy.

milestones.title: Passage Through Mirkwood
milestones.description: The heroes carry urgent tidings through the shadowed canopy of Mirkwood, warding off spiders and foul beasts.

milestones.title: Journey Along the Anduin
milestones.description: Sailing downstream upon the mighty Anduin, the company braves river ambushes and contends with a ferocious Hill Troll.

milestones.title: Escape from Dol Guldur
milestones.description: Infiltrating the dread fortress of the Necromancer, the fellowship rescues a captured comrade from subterranean dungeons.

milestones.title: The Oath
milestones.phase: Act IV - Gathering the Free Peoples
milestones.description: Honoring sacred alliances across the Wilderland, the party musters stalwart defenders to confront rising orc hordes.

milestones.title: The Caves of Nibin-Dûm
milestones.description: Venture into long-abandoned dwarven mines to uncover ancient relics and unearth lost lore before darkness spreads.

milestones.title: Assault on the Hill of Sorcery
milestones.phase: Act VI - Climax at the Fortress
milestones.description: A climactic confrontation where the assembled forces of Middle-earth assault the strongholds of darkness to seal evil away.
